title: Bench image
question: How should the bench image run?

options.label: Remapped to your user
options.description: Builds bench:$BENCH_TAG so bind-mounted files belong to USERID/GROUPID
notes: Build the wrapper image after changing BENCH_TAG: docker compose -f {output} build

title: Frappe branch
question: Frappe branch or tag for bench init
help: A branch (version-16, develop) can be updated later; a tag (v16.x.x) pins a release. A new value creates a new bench next to the old one.

title: App image
question: Application image (with your apps built in)
help: frappe/erpnext ships frappe + erpnext. For other apps build your own image (frappe_docker/docs/02-setup/02-build-setup.md).
